insight: Founded in 2017; its $12M Series A (Headline-led) counted Zoom's own Apps Fund among the backers.
name: Avoma
tagline: AI meeting assistant plus conversation and revenue intelligence for sales teams.
description: Avoma records, transcribes (75+ languages), and notes meetings with custom templates and an Ask Avoma copilot, then layers conversation intelligence with call scoring and talk-pattern analytics. Higher tiers add a scheduler, lead router, and revenue intelligence with deal-risk alerts and forecasting.
edge: Bundles notetaker, conversation intelligence, scheduler and forecasting in one tool at a fraction of Gong's per-seat cost.
pros: Far cheaper than Gong per seat
cons: Best features gated to higher tiers
